title: Staggered GA rollout & customer-readiness matrix for Private security suite
creator: Priya Rao
description: Goal: Coordinate a staged GA for the Private/VPC on-prem security suite (RBAC, audit logging, KMS integration) that minimizes blast radius, aligns enablement content, and creates a repeatable customer-readiness matrix. This ticket captures the rollout catalog, pilot gating criteria, cross-team owner list, communication schedule, and success metrics. Scope includes: GA gating for RBAC and KMS, audit log retention defaults and optional exports, onboarding checklist for Dedicated/Private customers, and runbooks for rollback and emergency support. Out of scope: changes to hosted API pricing or non-security feature work.
acceptance_criteria: Core GA checklist completed: security review signed, KMS key lifecycle documented, RBAC roles validated in staging
At least 3 pilot customers onboarded and exercised RBAC + KMS flows end-to-end without data loss
Audit log exports verified to S3/Cloud Storage for two cloud providers and on-prem agent validated
Console enablement tab and per-customer readiness matrix pages live in staging and accessible to solutions engineers
Rollback path tested: ability to revert a customer to a previous policy and disable KMS encryption without leaving data inaccessible
Release notes and customer-facing KB articles reviewed by legal and support and scheduled for GA publication
updates: 2026-02-26 Priya Rao: Drafted initial customer-readiness matrix and identified pilot candidates (three enterprise customers with active private deployments). Attached matrix to Confluence doc.
2026-03-02 Diego Martinez: Confirmed engineering scope for RBAC policy export/import. ENG-4012 will deliver the export endpoint by 2026-03-20. Added dependency to ticket.
2026-03-05 Security Review Notes (Emily Chen): KMS integration requires key rotation documentation and HSM compliance check. Marked security_review_required and added legal review step.

2026-03-08 PM Review: Decided to stagger GA features—GA will include RBAC baseline and audit log exports; KMS auto-rotation will be a post-GA patch to reduce initial complexity. Trade-off: slows full compliance automation but reduces rollout risk.

2026-03-10 Solutions Eng Sync (Diego): Created customer enablement checklist for pilot onboarding (networking pre-reqs, sample policies, test vectors). Made a lightweight script to validate audit log ingestion.

2026-03-12 Support Feedback (Carlos Vega): Must include escalations contact and SLA play for encryption failures. Added follow-up action to create a dedicated on-call rotation for first 4 weeks of GA.
rollout_phases: Phase 0 - Internal dogfooding (2026-03-15 to 2026-03-22): All SRE/SE teams run through RBAC/KMS flows in staging
Phase 1 - Pilot cohort (2026-03-23 to 2026-04-05): 3 customers onboarded sequentially, each held in 'pilot' with feature flags and extra monitoring
Phase 2 - Controlled expansion (2026-04-06 to 2026-04-12): Open to customers on Dedicated plans after checklist verification
Phase 3 - GA wide enablement (target 2026-04-15): Public release with release notes, KBs, webinar, and enablement office hours
Phase 4 - Post-GA stabilization (2026-04-16 to 2026-05-15): Metrics monitoring, minor patches (KMS auto-rotation patch planned), and retrospective
communication_plan: Pre-GA announcement to enterprise beta customers with pilot invite (email + account managers) - 2026-03-18
Internal launch kick-off: cross-functional town hall and runbook handoff - 2026-03-21
GA release notes drafted in repo and legal-reviewed (PR link in runbook_links) - publish on GA day
Customer webinar + Q&A scheduled for first GA week; Solutions Eng to host office hours
Post-GA follow-up survey for pilot customers to capture UX/ops friction and feature requests
risks_mitigation: Risk: KMS misconfiguration could cause key access failures. Mitigation: staged enablement per-customer, detailed preflight KMS checks, and rollback path documented.
Risk: Audit log volume spikes may exceed retention defaults. Mitigation: set conservative defaults, expose retention controls, and throttle export jobs in early weeks.
Risk: RBAC policy complexity causes support load. Mitigation: provide policy templates, SE-run onboarding, and add role simulator in console.
Risk: Regulatory requirement gaps for certain customers. Mitigation: maintain explicit customer-readiness matrix and require legal sign-off for at-risk customers prior to GA activation.
post_launch_metrics: Number of customers successfully onboarded to RBAC+KMS during pilot
MTTR for encryption-related incidents in first 30 days
Audit log ingestion success rate and export latency percentiles
Support ticket volume and triage time related to private security features
Feature adoption rate among Dedicated customers within 30 days of GA
